assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints derived from the public announcement text and repository provisional geometry.
assumptions.impact: They support design discussion and intake self-check only; official polygons must replace them and trigger recalculation of all dependent layers and metrics.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: AI scene concepts use public or consented data, data minimization, explainability, and human review.
assumptions.impact: No individual profiling, biometric inference, or autonomous enforcement is proposed.

assumptions.statement: Connections to Beiliwei Community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, E-Town, and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei are proposed collaboration interfaces, not confirmed partnerships or resource commitments.
assumptions.impact: Any cross-region activity requires named participants, rights clearance, a public agenda, and professional/administrative confirmation before operation.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, RACI roles, acceptance gates, and rollback paths are reference operating models; numeric thresholds, budgets, staffing, and liability remain unknown.
assumptions.impact: The package can define a testable concept but cannot claim approved operations, funding, or performance outcomes.
